sources.entry: Add Code Interpreter to your AI App

summary.name: E2B
summary.one_liner: E2B provides isolated cloud sandboxes, Linux VMs that AI agents can use to safely execute code, process data, and run tools.
use_cases: Run AI-generated code safely in an isolated environment
Let agents control virtual Linux desktops
Run tests and AI code reviews in GitHub Actions
Add a code interpreter to an AI app
summary.what_it_does: E2B offers sandboxes, which are fast, secure Linux VMs created on demand for an agent. Sandboxes can be paused and resumed, and pausing saves both filesystem and memory; paused sandboxes are kept indefinitely until killed. Templates define the environment a sandbox starts with. SDKs are used to start and manage sandboxes and run code. The docs are split into Quickstart, Examples (including Computer Use with E2B Desktop sandboxes and GitHub Actions CI/CD), and an SDK Reference. The docs also offer an MCP server and an llms.txt page index for AI coding agents.
notable: Pause and resume sandboxes, saving both filesystem and memory
Docs served for AI agents via MCP server at docs.e2b.dev/mcp and llms.txt
E2B Desktop sandboxes for computer use agents
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Paused sandboxes are kept only until you kill them
